title: Provenance-bearing typed comparison for before-and-after defeasible evidence
independentExamples: A declared obstruction attacks support for a nonce courier reaching a destination after a route update.
A declared repaired-state transition supports a nonce mechanism becoming operational after maintenance.
inputTypes: two or more opaque alternative identifiers
provenance-bearing typed support and attack records
declared family weights and minimum decision margin
preconditions: Every evidence record names a declared alternative and an allowlisted semantic family.
Evidence direction, integer strength, provenance origin, relation, and source reference are explicit.
The evidence producer, not the comparator, establishes the semantic validity of every record.
invariants: Alternative identifiers and evidence order do not affect scores.
An exact tie or insufficient margin returns UNKNOWN.
The method never invents causal, goal, state, contradiction, default, temporal, or participant evidence.
No source identity, row identity, vocabulary constant, or answer value participates in core control flow.
uncertaintySemantics: No evidence, exact ties, and margins below the declared threshold abstain explicitly. They are never converted into a binary guess.
proofBehavior: The witness freezes the normalized evidence digest, selected alternative, score margin, required margin, and evidence count; an independent verifier recomputes the result.
resourceBounds: Two through 32 alternatives, at most 2,048 validated evidence records, bounded integer strengths and family weights, and deterministic in-memory sorting.
kbMigration: None. The comparator remains an unregistered standalone module. The automatic event-frame projection is rejected, so no benchmark-derived evidence is promoted to a KB.
guardianReasons: Nonce/full-renaming, alternative and evidence permutation, semantic contrast, tie, missing-evidence, malformed-provenance, resource-bound, and tampered-witness controls pass.
The generic comparator is sound only relative to validated declared evidence and does not claim to derive commonsense evidence.
The automatic frame-overlap integration answered 5,519 of 14,968 development cases but was correct on only 2,721, so it is not eligible for runtime registration or a benchmark capability claim.
Missing causal, goal, normative, default, exception, and state-transition knowledge must remain explicit gaps rather than being replaced by lexical heuristics.
